title: JCGS attributed circular-boundary readiness deterministic-environment rerun
purpose: Repeat V5 unchanged while supplying the omitted deterministic cuBLAS workspace required before CUDA initialization.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 zero-optimizer V5R over the unchanged attributed C01 batch and prior C01-C08 readiness population; no checkpoint, threshold, C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User delegated autonomous best-method choices and requested continuous execution without repeated approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 deduplicated causal LiDAR shards.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective targets.

worlds.fit: No fit. Reconstruct the unchanged deterministic 128-row C01 failure batch and repeat prior readiness.
worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Exact V5 replay; only add CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 before CUDA subprocess creation.

teacher.source: Sealed continuous exit bearing/width/profile plus local axis and global geometry.
teacher.use: One exact loss forward/backward and prior zero-training checks; no identity.
teacher.valid_mask: Existing exact peak, width and global geometry masks.
teacher.student_input: Five causal normalized range/valid images only.

split.historical_pollution_audit: V5 failed before loss evaluation because the runner omitted the deterministic cuBLAS environment; it contributes no checkpoint or selection signal.

methods.main: Unchanged canonical periodic endpoint indexing, with deterministic cuBLAS workspace supplied before the CUDA child process starts.
methods.baseline: V5 stopped before the corrected loss because deterministic cuBLAS workspace was absent.
methods.fallback: If exact-batch CUDA forward/backward, finite gradients or prior readiness fails, stop JCGS before retraining.

acceptance.attribution: Uncorrected coordinate reproduces exactly one raw lower index 180 in the formal batch.
acceptance.periodic_semantics: Corrected coordinate maps that endpoint to 0; all corrected indices are 0..179 without clipping.
acceptance.cuda: Exact 128-row batch completes full JCGS loss forward/backward with finite gradients under deterministic cuBLAS.
acceptance.regression: All unit and prior readiness checks pass.

failure_policy: Fail closed. PASS authorizes only a new full from-scratch three-seed training run.
retention: Retain V5R boundary summary, logs, prior readiness evidence, environment, RUN_STATE and seal.

estimated_cost.compute: One deterministic CUDA batch forward/backward plus CPU readiness
